LESSON: MYSELF [

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: Myself [

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Myself [. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. interact and familiarize well with neighbours for harmonious co-existence
2. report to parents about the behaviour of the neighbours towards him/her for his/her self confidence.

4. identify the various forms  The learner to be guided to of fire for improvement in the quality of life
5. appreciate the importance of sun (Surya Devta) as a source of heat and light for fire in daily life through life.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Myself [.
2. Explain Myself [ to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Myself [.
4. Show that you can: interact and familiarize well with neighbours for harmonious co-existence
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Myself [. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Myself [ important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
